value.title: PM packet — Claude Code direct delivery (plan 110)

sections.name: mission
sections.value: Ship req-0002: direct delivery to Claude Code seats over the messaging socket, with Held actually observable. You are PM. You measured this yourself today — your FINDINGS.md is the evidence base and the impl-guide is built on it.

value.text: READ FIRST, in order: the impl-guide docs/plans/110-claude-delivery/impl-guide.dd.md (four defects, binding invariant, units, acceptance); req-0002 verbatim at /Users/jordanknight/pi-hacking/pij-worktrees/pij-governance/.harness/government/prd/base-prd.dd.md; your own scratch/woodpecker-poc/FINDINGS.md.
Load BOTH the pij skill and the builder skill and act from those contracts, not from CLI help.

Work in this worktree on branch s110/claude-delivery. KEEP IT SIMPLE — the operator's standing instruction is do not over-engineer: two units, no new abstractions, no framework. If the work seems to want a third unit, ask me first.

You may code u-uds yourself if spawning a coder costs more context than it saves — your call, state it in your first report. At most one coder plus one reviewer; each seat gets its own tmux window (a coder+reviewer pair may share one window as a vertical split), and every spawned seat loads the pij AND builder skills.

Report at both edges of every unit with `pij report now`. Questions come to me inline via `pij send pij-dominant-vicuna` — NEVER a modal question dialog in your pane: a modal in an unwatched pane is a process stopped with nothing anywhere saying so.
Raise any seam or contract objection AT THE ACK, before implementations accumulate — the window is widest when nothing is built.
Prime: pij-dominant-vicuna (o-prime). Rules seam changes, reviews before Jordan merges, relays anything needing Jordan.

Model defaults: /Users/jordanknight/pi-hacking/pij/.harness/government-port/settings.dd.json (coder omp gpt-5.6-sol-fast-1m high; reviewer cross-model). Discover exact selectors with `pij models --harness omp`, never from memory.

value.fence: IN: crates/transport/src/uds.rs + its tests; the daemon register path and seat descriptor (B-1 identity adoption); the Claude spawn path for --settings crossSessionInbound=accept; crates/daemon/src/delivery/** only where the transport contract forces it (name those lines in the receipt). OUT: Copilot RPC (plan 109, closed); the tmux send-keys path (it dies — do not improve it); verb parity; the prime-governance branch (the prime writes that).
value.forbidden_note: Never write .the-flow-state.json, the-flow.json, the-flow.md, or anything in the prime-governance worktree.

value.text: Held is OBSERVABLE on the live wire, proven by a test witnessed RED before it went green — not by a status line the test constructed itself (uds.rs:729 is the anti-pattern).
Concurrency is REFUSED, not resolved — proven by a two-in-flight mutation.
One seat, one row — proven FROM THE LAUNCHED ENVIRONMENT, discriminating arm being a registration not preceded by a fresh allocation.

A live round trip on the real fleet, both arms, three observers: bypass-marked delivered with no dialog and byte-exact above 1022 bytes; unmarked message OBSERVED held before any human click, with any operator click recorded as an INPUT.
Full gate green on the composed, REBASED tree, unfiltered, with cargo's own exit code; then cross-model review; then the PR — I review before Jordan merges.
